benchmark.written_against: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS (also exercised on Ubuntu 24.04 LTS)
benchmark.note: Each check cites the CIS recommendation by title. Recommendation numbers change between benchmark versions, so cis_id is empty by default. Fill it in as a quoted string (for example "1.1.1.1") from the benchmark version your organization has adopted and it will appear in every report.

checks.title: Ensure mounting of cramfs filesystems is disabled
checks.actual: cramfs is not built in and this kernel has no loadable module support
checks.expected: The cramfs kernel module is not loaded and cannot be loaded
checks.remediation: Create /etc/modprobe.d/cramfs.conf containing "install cramfs /bin/false" and "blacklist cramfs", then run "modprobe -r cramfs".

soc2.control_name: Configuration standards and detection of configuration changes

checks.title: Ensure mounting of squashfs filesystems is disabled
checks.actual: squashfs is available in the running kernel (listed in /proc/filesystems)
checks.expected: The squashfs kernel module is not loaded and cannot be loaded
checks.remediation: Create /etc/modprobe.d/squashfs.conf containing "install squashfs /bin/false" and "blacklist squashfs". Do not apply this on hosts that use snap packages.

soc2.control_name: Configuration standards and detection of configuration changes

checks.title: Ensure mounting of udf filesystems is disabled
checks.actual: udf is not built in and this kernel has no loadable module support
checks.expected: The udf kernel module is not loaded and cannot be loaded
checks.remediation: Create /etc/modprobe.d/udf.conf containing "install udf /bin/false" and "blacklist udf", then run "modprobe -r udf".

soc2.control_name: Configuration standards and detection of configuration changes

checks.title: Ensure /tmp is a separate partition
checks.expected: /tmp is its own mount point
checks.remediation: Mount /tmp as its own file system, for example with the systemd tmp.mount unit or an /etc/fstab entry.

soc2.control_name: Configuration standards and detection of configuration changes

checks.title: Ensure noexec option set on /tmp partition
checks.expected: /tmp is mounted with the noexec option
checks.remediation: Add noexec to the mount options for /tmp in /etc/fstab or tmp.mount, then remount.

soc2.control_name: Prevention and detection of unauthorized or malicious software
Configuration standards and detection of configuration changes

checks.title: Ensure nodev option set on /tmp partition
checks.expected: /tmp is mounted with the nodev option
checks.remediation: Add nodev to the mount options for /tmp in /etc/fstab or tmp.mount, then remount.

soc2.control_name: Configuration standards and detection of configuration changes

checks.title: Ensure nosuid option set on /tmp partition
checks.expected: /tmp is mounted with the nosuid option
checks.remediation: Add nosuid to the mount options for /tmp in /etc/fstab or tmp.mount, then remount.

soc2.control_name: Role-based access and least privilege
Configuration standards and detection of configuration changes

checks.title: Ensure password expiration is 365 days or less
checks.expected: PASS_MAX_DAYS in /etc/login.defs is between 1 and 365
checks.remediation: Set PASS_MAX_DAYS to 365 or less in /etc/login.defs and run "chage --maxdays 365 <user>" for existing accounts.

soc2.control_name: Logical access security over protected information assets

checks.title: Ensure minimum days between password changes is configured
checks.expected: PASS_MIN_DAYS in /etc/login.defs is 1 or more
checks.remediation: Set PASS_MIN_DAYS to 1 or more in /etc/login.defs and run "chage --mindays 1 <user>" for existing accounts.

soc2.control_name: Logical access security over protected information assets

checks.title: Ensure password expiration warning days is 7 or more
checks.expected: PASS_WARN_AGE in /etc/login.defs is 7 or more
checks.remediation: Set PASS_WARN_AGE to 7 or more in /etc/login.defs.

soc2.control_name: Logical access security over protected information assets

checks.title: Ensure inactive password lock is 30 days or less
checks.expected: The useradd default INACTIVE is between 0 and 30 days
checks.remediation: Run "useradd -D -f 30" and "chage --inactive 30 <user>" for existing accounts.

soc2.control_name: Registration and removal of user access

checks.title: Ensure root is the only UID 0 account
checks.actual: root is the only UID 0 account
checks.expected: root is the only account with UID 0 in /etc/passwd
checks.remediation: Remove every other UID 0 account or give it a unique non-zero UID.

soc2.control_name: Role-based access and least privilege

checks.title: Ensure root login is restricted to system console
checks.actual: pam_securetty is not enabled in /etc/pam.d/login, so /etc/securetty is not consulted on this host
checks.expected: Where pam_securetty is in use, /etc/securetty exists and lists only approved consoles
checks.remediation: Review /etc/securetty and remove every terminal that is not physically secured.

soc2.control_name: Role-based access and least privilege

checks.title: Ensure SSH root login is disabled
checks.expected: The effective sshd setting PermitRootLogin is "no"
checks.remediation: Set "PermitRootLogin no" in /etc/ssh/sshd_config or a drop-in file and reload sshd.

soc2.control_name: Logical access security over protected information assets
Protection against threats from outside the system boundary

checks.title: Ensure SSH PermitEmptyPasswords is disabled
checks.expected: The effective sshd setting PermitEmptyPasswords is "no"
checks.remediation: Set "PermitEmptyPasswords no" in /etc/ssh/sshd_config or a drop-in file and reload sshd.

soc2.control_name: Logical access security over protected information assets
Protection against threats from outside the system boundary

checks.title: Review SSH PasswordAuthentication against site policy
checks.expected: Password logins over SSH are either disabled or documented as an approved exception
checks.remediation: Set "PasswordAuthentication no" and use keys or certificates, unless site policy documents a need for password logins.

soc2.control_name: Logical access security over protected information assets
Protection against threats from outside the system boundary

checks.title: Ensure SSH MaxAuthTries is set to 4 or less
checks.expected: The effective sshd setting MaxAuthTries is 4 or less
checks.remediation: Set "MaxAuthTries 4" in /etc/ssh/sshd_config or a drop-in file and reload sshd.

soc2.control_name: Logical access security over protected information assets

checks.title: Ensure IP forwarding is disabled
checks.expected: net.ipv4.ip_forward and net.ipv6.conf.all.forwarding are 0 in the running kernel
checks.remediation: Set net.ipv4.ip_forward=0 and net.ipv6.conf.all.forwarding=0 in a file under /etc/sysctl.d and run "sysctl --system".

soc2.control_name: Protection against threats from outside the system boundary

checks.title: Ensure packet redirect sending is disabled
checks.expected: net.ipv4.conf.all.send_redirects and net.ipv4.conf.default.send_redirects are 0
checks.remediation: Set both send_redirects keys to 0 in a file under /etc/sysctl.d and run "sysctl --system".

soc2.control_name: Protection against threats from outside the system boundary

checks.title: Ensure source routed packets are not accepted
checks.actual: net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route = 0, net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route = 1; IPv6 is not enabled
checks.expected: accept_source_route is 0 for "all" and "default" on IPv4 and on IPv6 where IPv6 is enabled
checks.remediation: Set the accept_source_route keys to 0 in a file under /etc/sysctl.d and run "sysctl --system".

soc2.control_name: Protection against threats from outside the system boundary

checks.title: Ensure ICMP redirects are not accepted
checks.actual: net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects = 1, net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects = 1; IPv6 is not enabled
checks.expected: accept_redirects is 0 for "all" and "default" on IPv4 and on IPv6 where IPv6 is enabled
checks.remediation: Set the accept_redirects keys to 0 in a file under /etc/sysctl.d and run "sysctl --system".

soc2.control_name: Protection against threats from outside the system boundary

checks.title: Ensure broadcast ICMP requests are ignored
checks.expected: net.ipv4.icmp_echo_ignore_broadcasts is 1
checks.remediation: Set net.ipv4.icmp_echo_ignore_broadcasts=1 in a file under /etc/sysctl.d and run "sysctl --system".

soc2.control_name: Protection against threats from outside the system boundary

checks.title: Ensure TCP SYN Cookies is enabled
checks.expected: net.ipv4.tcp_syncookies is 1
checks.remediation: Set net.ipv4.tcp_syncookies=1 in a file under /etc/sysctl.d and run "sysctl --system".

soc2.control_name: Protection against threats from outside the system boundary

checks.title: Ensure a host firewall is active
checks.actual: iptables has no rules and accepts by default
checks.expected: ufw, firewalld, nftables or iptables is active with a filtering rule set
checks.remediation: Enable one host firewall, for example "ufw enable" after allowing the services the host needs.

soc2.control_name: Protection against threats from outside the system boundary

checks.title: Ensure rsyslog is installed
checks.expected: The rsyslog package is installed
checks.remediation: Install rsyslog with "apt install rsyslog".

soc2.control_name: Monitoring of system components for anomalies

checks.title: Ensure rsyslog service is enabled
checks.expected: The rsyslog unit is enabled
checks.remediation: Run "systemctl --now enable rsyslog".

soc2.control_name: Monitoring of system components for anomalies

checks.title: Ensure journald is configured to compress large log files
checks.expected: Compress=yes is set in the journald configuration
checks.remediation: Set Compress=yes in /etc/systemd/journald.conf or a drop-in under /etc/systemd/journald.conf.d and restart systemd-journald.

soc2.control_name: Monitoring of system components for anomalies

checks.title: Ensure journald is configured to write logfiles to persistent disk
checks.expected: Storage=persistent is set in the journald configuration
checks.remediation: Set Storage=persistent in /etc/systemd/journald.conf or a drop-in under /etc/systemd/journald.conf.d and restart systemd-journald.

soc2.control_name: Monitoring of system components for anomalies

checks.title: Ensure permissions on /var/log are configured
checks.expected: /var/log is owned by root with group root, adm or syslog and is not writable by others
checks.remediation: Run "chown root /var/log" and "chmod o-w /var/log".

soc2.control_name: Monitoring of system components for anomalies
Logical access security over protected information assets

checks.title: Ensure permissions on /etc/passwd are configured
checks.expected: /etc/passwd is owned by root:root with mode 0644 or more restrictive
checks.remediation: Run "chown root:root /etc/passwd" and "chmod u-x,go-wx /etc/passwd".

soc2.control_name: Logical access security over protected information assets
Role-based access and least privilege

checks.title: Ensure permissions on /etc/shadow are configured
checks.expected: /etc/shadow is owned by root, group root or shadow, with mode 0640 or more restrictive
checks.remediation: Run "chown root:shadow /etc/shadow" and "chmod u-x,g-wx,o-rwx /etc/shadow".

soc2.control_name: Logical access security over protected information assets
Role-based access and least privilege

checks.title: Ensure permissions on /etc/group are configured
checks.expected: /etc/group is owned by root:root with mode 0644 or more restrictive
checks.remediation: Run "chown root:root /etc/group" and "chmod u-x,go-wx /etc/group".

soc2.control_name: Logical access security over protected information assets
Role-based access and least privilege

checks.title: Ensure no world writable files exist
checks.actual: no world writable files on local file systems
checks.expected: No regular file on a local file system is writable by "other"
checks.remediation: Review each file and run "chmod o-w <file>" where world write access is not required.

soc2.control_name: Logical access security over protected information assets
Role-based access and least privilege

checks.title: Ensure no unowned or ungrouped files or directories exist
checks.actual: every file and directory on local file systems has an owner and a group
checks.expected: Every file and directory on a local file system has a known owner and group
checks.remediation: Assign each file to a valid account with "chown <user>:<group> <path>" or remove it.

soc2.control_name: Logical access security over protected information assets

checks.title: Review SUID and SGID executables
checks.actual: 16 SUID or SGID files to compare with your baseline, for example: /usr/bin/chage, /usr/bin/chfn, /usr/bin/chsh, /usr/bin/crontab, /usr/bin/expiry (and 11 more)
checks.expected: Every SUID or SGID executable is known and justified
checks.remediation: Compare the list with your approved baseline and remove the bit with "chmod u-s,g-s <file>" where it is not needed.

soc2.control_name: Role-based access and least privilege

checks.title: Ensure xinetd is not installed
checks.expected: The xinetd package is not installed
checks.remediation: Remove it with "apt purge xinetd".

soc2.control_name: Configuration standards and detection of configuration changes

checks.title: Ensure telnet server is not installed
checks.actual: no telnet server package is installed
checks.expected: No telnet server package is installed
checks.remediation: Remove it with "apt purge telnetd inetutils-telnetd" and use SSH.

soc2.control_name: Protection of information in transmission
Configuration standards and detection of configuration changes

checks.title: Ensure FTP server is not installed
checks.actual: no FTP server package is installed
checks.expected: No FTP server package is installed
checks.remediation: Remove it with "apt purge vsftpd" and use SFTP.

soc2.control_name: Protection of information in transmission

checks.title: Ensure HTTP server is not installed unless required
checks.actual: no web server package is installed
checks.expected: No web server package is installed unless the host is documented as needing one
checks.remediation: Remove the web server if this host does not need one, for example "apt purge apache2 nginx".

soc2.control_name: Configuration standards and detection of configuration changes

checks.title: Ensure LDAP server is not installed unless required
checks.actual: no LDAP server package is installed
checks.expected: No LDAP server package is installed unless the host is documented as needing one
checks.remediation: Remove slapd if this host is not a directory server, with "apt purge slapd".

soc2.control_name: Configuration standards and detection of configuration changes

checks.title: Ensure NFS is not installed unless required
checks.actual: no NFS server package is installed
checks.expected: No NFS server package is installed unless the host is documented as needing one
checks.remediation: Remove the NFS server if this host does not export file systems, with "apt purge nfs-kernel-server".
